title: members.yaml, the people of a brain
description: Who belongs to a brain and with which public keys (wi-brain-identity): the people (Person), their accounts elsewhere (Account), the organizations and tenants they belong to (Organization) and their roles per project, organization or tenant (Membership). Public keys only: a private key never enters this file, the engine only verifies signatures with these keys (brain.identity). The file sits at the brain's root, next to config.json; its data class is confidential (names, accounts). Without it nothing about identity is checked.

class.description: The file's data class, said in the file too (declare it in config.json classes.stores as well).

person_id.description: A stable id: never reused, never renamed (signatures name it as their principal).

signing.description: Public SSH ed25519 signing keys, one per machine or hardware key: what verifies the person's signed answers (ssh-keygen -Y verify, namespace brain-decision).

key.description: The public half, as the .pub file holds it: type, base64, optional comment.

machine.description: Where its private half lives (a label, never a path).

since.description: The day the key was declared: answers recorded before the earliest since of the deciders' keys need no signature.

revoked.description: The day the key was revoked (a record of when): from then on it verifies nothing, a signature it made before included, since the date written in an answer is not proof of when it was signed; the owner signs those answers again with another key.

encryption.description: Public age recipients (brain vault seals to them).

accounts.description: A person's accounts elsewhere (a code host, an identity provider), linked by both sides' proof, never by an e-mail address alone.

subject.description: The login or the OIDC sub.

kind.description: A tenant is another brain's identity and key domain (HMaaS); default organization.

memberships.description: A person's roles: on the whole brain (no project, organization nor tenant), on one project of the registry, or in an organization or tenant. decider: the person whose signature verifies an owner-decides answer; owner, member and viewer are read by later checks.
